zh-Hans.text:
刘备再次拥立献帝,
失去关羽张飞后,
后事交给孔明,
回平原过完一生。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
劉備再次擁立獻帝,
失去關羽張飛後,
後事交給孔明,
回平原過完一生。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

review_notes: Four-line alternate-ending narrative; compresses the source into the fixed four-line budget while retaining Liu Bei, Emperor Xian, the loss of Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, Zhuge Liang, and the return to Pingyuan. 獻 uses the E-specific bounded custom map; natural ending-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.

zh-Hans.text:
孔明在汉朝行善政,
国家兴盛、人民安宁,
他死后无人领导,
乱世再临。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
孔明在漢朝行善政,
國家興盛、人民安寧,
他死後無人領導,
亂世再臨。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

review_notes: Four-line alternate-ending narrative; retains the benevolent-government, prosperity, peace, and return of chaos structure within the fixed four-line budget. 亂 and 國 use the E-specific bounded custom map; natural ending-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.
